description: A three-way router driven by voltage: the control CV picks one of three zones, and the CV and any incoming trigger are sent to that zone's pair of jacks.

params.text: Sets the boundary between the middle and the high zone, -5V to +10V; it cannot be taken below the LOW knob.
Sets the boundary between the low and the middle zone, -5V to +10V; it cannot be taken above the HIGH knob.

inputs.text: The control voltage that picks the zone, clamped to -5V through +10V; with nothing patched here a trigger generates a random voltage instead.
A rising edge sends a 1ms trigger out of whichever zone the control voltage is in, and with no control CV patched it also rolls a fresh random voltage.
A signal to route instead of the control voltage; the zone is chosen by the control voltage, and this is what comes out of that zone.

outputs.text: Carries the routed voltage while the control voltage is at or above the high cutoff.
A 10V trigger 1ms long when a trigger arrives while the control voltage is at or above the high cutoff.
Carries the routed voltage while the control voltage is between the two cutoffs.
A 10V trigger 1ms long when a trigger arrives while the control voltage is between the two cutoffs.
Carries the routed voltage while the control voltage is at or below the low cutoff.
A 10V trigger 1ms long when a trigger arrives while the control voltage is at or below the low cutoff.

notes: A zone's CV output keeps the last voltage that was sent to it, so two of the three always hold an old value unless the menu's mute item is on.
With a trigger patched and no control CV, the module becomes a three-way random trigger, and the two cutoff knobs set how likely each zone is.
menu: Sample and Hold Control CV — makes the zone follow the control voltage only at the moment a trigger arrives, rather than tracking it continuously; it needs a trigger patched to do anything.
Mute Non-Active Outputs To 0V — ramps the two inactive CV outputs down to 0V instead of leaving them at their last voltage.
Random CV Range: -5V to 10V, -5V to 5V, 0V to 10V, 0V to 5V — sets the span of the random voltage generated on a trigger when no control CV is patched.
Output Trigger on CV Zone Change — fires a zone's trigger output when the control voltage moves into that zone; it does nothing while the sample and hold item is on.

inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.

outputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
outputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
